notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
This update has been cooking for a while now, so I hope players enjoy it!

It Includes:

[list]
[*] New Backend Systems for Battles and Text Dialogue designed for a cleaner experience.  
[*] New Details added to enemy battles for more variety!
[*] New Text Flavor choices!
[*] Added TRUE Reset Button.
[/list]

There's been a lot of discussion in this community about finicky controls, and I just want to make this clear again:
If you are having troubles when game controls, or any other bugs, please report it to [url=https://discord.gg/Uq6552cT2n]The Twelve Slot Saloon Discord Server[/url]. 
These control issues might be due to the way Godot's game engine works, but if not, I want to help design the game to player's preferences.

Anyway, that's all for now!

Take care, and I hope you're able to have fun with this new update.

-James Yevon.

notes.title: The Twelve Slot Saloon Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]The Twelve Slot Saloon Demo is now available for all to play![/h3]

It's been cooking in the oven for awhile, but you can now finally experience "The Land Without Happy Endings" for yourself!

If you run into any bugs, be sure to let me know in [b]The Twelve Slot Saloon Discord Server[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/Uq6552cT2n]Join The Twelve Slot Saloon Discord Server![/url]

I hope you all have fun, and here's to hoping you find a happy ending!
